en.description:
Obstacle Fiesta is a vibrant, character-driven arcade survival game designed specifically for Apple Watch.

Guide a lovable snowman through a festive world filled with colorful hazards and dynamic events. Use the Digital Crown to control movement flow and tap the screen to jump at just the right moment. Every successful run helps your magical sombrero grow larger, visually representing progress and giving you more room to survive as the challenge intensifies.

As your score increases, the environment transforms with new visual themes, surprising obstacles, and celebratory effects. From rising stone idols to erupting volcanoes and swirling storms, each session delivers fast, satisfying gameplay designed for short bursts on your wrist.

Features:
• Character-based arcade survival gameplay
• Unique sombrero progression system
• Tap-to-jump mechanics with vivid visual effects
• Dynamic environments that evolve with your score
• Intuitive Digital Crown + tap controls
• Optimized performance for Apple Watch

Obstacle Fiesta focuses on joyful visuals, expressive character animation, and easy-to-learn controls that make it perfect for quick play sessions anytime, anywhere.
en.releaseNotes: Introduced Ghost Gnome enemy with a new silhouette (smaller, faster, trickier to spot)

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Shadow Racing Update

Race against your past self! Your best runs are now recorded and replayed as colorful ghost snowmen that race alongside you in real time.

- Up to 50 ghost replays from your top-scoring runs
- Each ghost is color-coded Pac-Man style (red, pink, cyan, orange, purple) so you can tell them apart
- Date and time labels float above each ghost so you know which run it is
- Ghosts are transparent and don't interfere with gameplay
- Your recordings are saved between sessions — build up a full field of rivals over time
- Improved restart reliability — no more spawning at the crash site when restarting during explosions
Introduced Ghost Gnome enemy with a new silhouette (smaller, faster, trickier to spot)
